evals.name: Type-Safe Strapi Client & SSR TransferState Caching
evals.prompt: Implement a generic StrapiService in Angular utilizing TransferState caching to prevent duplicate API queries during SSR hydration.
evals.expected_output: Creates StrapiService with getWithTransferState() checking transferState.hasKey on client and transferState.set on server using isPlatformBrowser.
assertions: Implements StrapiService with generic get and getWithTransferState methods
Utilizes TransferState makeStateKey to serialize data on the server
Consumes and evicts transferred state on client hydration
Injects PLATFORM_ID to guard server vs browser execution

evals.name: Dynamic Media Resolution & StrapiMediaPipe
evals.prompt: Build a standalone StrapiMediaPipe to resolve relative Strapi upload paths against environment.strapiApiUrl while preserving absolute cloud storage URLs.
evals.expected_output: Creates a standalone pipe that returns absolute URLs untouched and prepends baseUrl to relative paths starting with /.
assertions: Declares standalone pipe with name strapiMedia
Preserves external absolute URLs beginning with http:// or https://
Prepends configured baseUrl to relative media paths
Handles null, undefined, and empty string inputs gracefully

evals.name: Zero-Hardcoding Invariant & Proactive Schema Prompting
evals.prompt: Enforce zero hardcoded copy in Angular components consuming Strapi and provide a proactive schema prompt when a required field is absent from the CMS.
evals.expected_output: Binds all copy dynamically from Strapi models and outputs a copy-pasteable prompt for Strapi when required schema fields are missing.
assertions: Enforces zero hardcoded text strings in component templates
Defines typed StrapiDocument interfaces with flat v5 schema properties
Provides structured proactive schema prompt template for missing CMS fields
Enforces zero explicit any type annotations across models and services
